local-compose-v2.description: Provisional reference environment for release-over-release development measurements on a single laptop. It is not representative of production server capacity.
interpretation: Konifer is limited to 2 CPUs and 8 GiB of memory; PostgreSQL and MinIO are each limited to 1 CPU and 1 GiB.
Konifer, PostgreSQL, MinIO, and the host-based k6 load generator compete for the same physical CPU, memory, and storage.
Use these results to compare releases measured under this same profile, not to estimate production capacity or compare against other hardware.
